newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet Cabinet on budget, foreign policy.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet Cabinet on budget, foreign policy.

text.p: President Bill Clinton was scheduled to meet his Cabinet Monday to discuss the U.S. balanced budget agreement and to go over his administration's foreign policy priorities, the White House said.

Spokesman Barry Toiv told reporters that the meeting, due to begin at 1115 EDT, would cover implementation of the balanced budget agreement reached by Clinton and the Republican leaders of Congress on May 2.
The agreement, which seeks to balance the U.S. federal budget by 2002, is making its way through Congress, which must translate the rough outline into legislation on spending and taxes.
Toiv said the meeting would allow Cabinet members to receive a briefing on Clinton's foreign policy priorities. He gave no further details.
